magic.note: Any nonzero two-basis difference in F3^3 can be carried to a single-qutrit coordinate by invertible GL3(F3) Clifford permutation, so Wigner L1 is the same for any active pair. Inactive basis outputs are stabilizer basis states.

optics.hardware_model: 6 simultaneous two-port rotation gates with independent Gaussian angular jitter sigma_theta, 12 active output phases sigma_phi, active output arm power transmission eta, 15 idle ideal; no crosstalk, source/detector errors or interdevice loss
optics.performance_limit: Illustrative numerical error model only, no laboratory calibration or fault-tolerance threshold. This elementary V is E6-preserving but NOT Clifford-conjugate to original CCZ U because order-three spectra differ.
